title: BA (Hons) Health & Social Care
description: A flexible BA Health & Social Care degree for working adults. Compare salary, Student Finance support, study modes and entry routes before you apply.

section_3.title: A degree dedicated to caring for others.
section_3.description: Gain the skills to lead care services, manage NHS administration projects, and coordinate healthcare systems in local government.

cards.title: Who it suits
cards.description: Individuals with a strong empathy for others, support workers looking to step up into management, and adult learners wanting to work in the public sector or NHS.

cards.title: What you'll learn
cards.description: Communication in care, safeguarding legislation, social policy, community health, service management, and public health policies.

cards.title: Assessment style
cards.description: Primarily reports, presentations, and reflective journals tracking personal growth and care compliance, with minimal written hall exams.

section_4.description: Explore roles in community health, social services, and care compliance.

section_15.title: Questions before applying.
section_15.description: Clear answers reduce uncertainty before you apply.

faqs.question: Can I study part-time?
faqs.answer: The course is full-time designated but structured on a blended model, so attendance is only required 2 days a week.

faqs.question: Are there placement hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most Health & Social Care pathways recommend local placement projects to verify your competence.

faqs.question: Can I progress to social work?
faqs.answer: Yes, this degree builds the exact academic foundation to join a certified Master's in Social Work.
